description: Estimate what a task would cost to do by people across countries: pass task_description and countries (names or ISO codes), and optionally currency (default EUR), complexity (low, medium or high) and estimated_time_minutes. It makes a model call, billed to your provider key when you set one and to the platform's otherwise. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

countries.description: The countries to estimate for, as names or ISO codes.

currency.description: The currency to show costs in. Defaults to EUR.

estimated_time_minutes.description: How long the task takes one person, in minutes.

name: estimate_task_cost
